notes: Page texts give no tuition fee for this programme, so no tuition fact is included. The applicationChannel quote from the VIK admission page is general ("All applications must be submitted on-line") and does not name a platform; treated as direct university application (hu-university-direct), but the Stipendium Hungaricum route is also mentioned for scholarship applicants ("For Stipendium Hungaricum Applicants"). Language proficiency appears as B2/IELTS 5.0/TOEFL iBT 72 on the Studyfinder page; the VIK page adds older TOEFL thresholds (iBT 4.0, PBT 550) and states IELTS 5.0 is recommended for BSc but required for MSc/PhD, so certificate requirements should be verified manually. Duration: 7 semesters (210 credits) = 3.5 years.
